The main takeaway from our work is that
the substitution of Lys for Phe in Pis-1 can reduce its cytotoxicity while retaining its antibacterial activity.
the substitution of Val10 with Lys in Pis-1 can enhance the amphipathicity of Pis-1 and improve the selectivity of Pis-1 against bacteria.
